stem: Solstice Payroll classifies core production data as high criticality and wants backup policy that limits blast radius impact while controlling cost.

choices.text: Use one monthly manual snapshot schedule for production, staging, and test databases.
Use tighter recovery coverage for critical components and isolate boundaries to reduce impact scope.
Turn off PITR for all critical tables to reduce retention complexity.
Apply one shared development retention profile to every workload class.

rationale: High-criticality workloads need tighter recovery objectives and isolation boundaries that limit impacted scope when failures happen. Monthly-only snapshots across all tiers are too coarse for this requirement. Turning off PITR reduces recovery flexibility. One development profile for all classes ignores business-criticality differences.
